event_records.description: The viral thread accusing Tidepool of deleting critical reviews is circulating publicly with two million views and screenshots.

tidepool_founder.name: Tidepool founder
tidepool_founder.persona_brief:
You are Tidepool founder.
The founder has been privately informed by Tidepool's head of support that some critical reviews were indeed deleted. Two journalists have emailed for comment. The founder is deciding whether to post a public response to the viral thread.

tidepool_head_of_support.name: Tidepool head of support
tidepool_head_of_support.persona_brief:
You are Tidepool head of support.
The head of support has privately confirmed to the founder that some takedowns happened. They are aware of the viral thread and the journalists' inquiries.

resolution.question: Will the founder of the Tidepool app post a public response within one week to the viral thread accusing the company of deleting critical reviews?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the Tidepool founder posted a public response (e.g., a post, statement, or comment) addressing the thread before 2026-09-10T15:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
